temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days; when Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed with work and some personal stuff.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is normally engaging; her recent quietness is uncharacteristic, so Carolyn suspects something may be wrong but does not know what.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn learns that Marilyn's quietness is likely due to being overwhelmed by work and personal matters.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is going through an overwhelming period involving work and personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, sympathetic, and somewhat relieved that Marilyn responded.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and be available if Marilyn wants to talk.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn had been curt in a later interaction; when Carolyn shares her own tough experiences, Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is overwhelmed, but her curtness made Carolyn wonder if she overstepped or if Marilyn was upset; Carolyn feels confused and slightly hurt.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn learns Marilyn's curtness was due to a hard week, not necessarily a rejection or Carolyn's overstep.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Marilyn is struggling but appreciates Carolyn's support; the misunderstanding is eased.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initially confused and hurt; afterward relieved, empathetic, and cautiously reassured.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To show support, clear the misunderstanding, and respect Marilyn's boundaries.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responds positively to Carolyn's openness; when invited to a small weekend gathering, Marilyn says it sounds lovely, thanks Carolyn, and says she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Marilyn is having a hard week but has responded positively to Carolyn's support, so Carolyn feels relieved and hopeful about a budding friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's enthusiastic acceptance confirms she is open to socializing and deepening the friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their friendship is developing, and Marilyn wants to attend Carolyn's gathering.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To host the gathering and strengthen her friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as maintaining professional distance at the bank; when Carolyn raises it, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they have a friendly connection outside work, but at work Marilyn remains professionally distant; Carolyn feels disappointed and wants to understand why.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Carolyn learns the distance may not be intentional and that Marilyn is open to discussing and improving their work dynamic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: There is a chance to resolve the professional distance; Marilyn is willing to improve collaboration, though the issue still needs discussion.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Disappointed and confused before the conversation; afterward cautiously relieved and somewhat optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To address the work dynamic directly and improve collaboration with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Marilyn agrees enthusiastically to team up on the new project proposal, says she is glad they had the talk, and looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believes they cleared the air and now better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries; she feels content and optimistic.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Marilyn's agreement and positive response confirm the improved partnership and validate Carolyn's optimism.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes they have a stronger, mutually understood professional relationship and can collaborate closely on the new project.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To collaborate with Marilyn on the new project and further their partnership.
